cat > /usr/local/sbin/traffic-mirror-node1.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
ip addr add 10.100.121.10/24 dev eth0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link add gretap1 type gretap local 10.100.121.10 remote 10.100.121.12 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set gretap1 up
tc qdisc add dev eth0 clsact 2>/dev/null || true
tc filter add dev eth0 ingress protocol ip flower src_ip 10.100.121.11 action mirred egress mirror dev gretap1 2>/dev/null || true
tc filter add dev eth0 egress protocol ip flower dst_ip 10.100.121.11 action mirred egress mirror dev gretap1 2>/dev/null || true
tc filter add dev eth0 ingress protocol arp flower action mirred egress mirror dev gretap1 2>/dev/null || true
tc filter add dev eth0 egress protocol arp flower action mirred egress mirror dev gretap1 2>/dev/null || true
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/traffic-mirror-node1.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/traffic-mirror.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Mirror node1<->node2 traffic to node3 via gretap
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/traffic-mirror-node1.sh
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable traffic-mirror.service
systemctl is-enabled traffic-mirror.service
